director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj fractions ko cricket ke equal shares se dekhenge. Tumhara favourite cricket player kaun hai?
Riya, cricket pasand hai—badhiya! Golu ko tum kaise samjhaogi?
Haan Riya, lesson ek minute ruk sakta hai. Kis baare mein baat karni hai? Iske baad fraction par lautenge.
Riya, ek roti ke 3 barabar hisse hon, toh har hissa one-third kehlata hai; batao, kul kitne hisse hain?
Riya, tumne kaha “pata nahi”; chalo 3 barabar slices wali pizza imagine karo. Har slice ek-third hai—kul slices kitne?
Chalo game: main ek whole ko 4 equal parts sochti hoon. Tum batao, ek part ko fraction mein kaise bolenge?
Riya, tumne 3 bola; main 4 equal parts mein ek part ko one-fourth rakhti hoon. Ab tum next move bolo.
Riya, tum keh rahi ho ki yeh part boring hai—no guilt. Ab choose karo: picture, story, ya fraction-game?
Riya, kaunsa choose karogi: Picture dikhao, Kahani mein batao, ya Game khelte hain?
Story: ek pizza ko teen barabar groups mein baanta. Fraction 1/3 ka matlab hai, ek of kitne equal groups?
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.

director.text: Theek hai Riya, tum aaj ke liye stop karna chahti ho—carry on, short break, ya stop for today?
